mapper.sql: IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, ORIGIN_CD, FILE_DATE, FILE_SHA256, FILE_BYTES, ITEM_COUNT, DOC_COUNT, WARN_COUNT, BATCH_ID, IMPORTED_BY, IMPORTED_AT, IMPORTED_VERIFIED
DOC_ID, IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, DOC_SEQ, TITLE, SRC_KIND_CD, PERIOD_FROM, PERIOD_TO, SRC_URL, URL_MISSING, CHECKED_ON, COLLECTOR_AGENT, PAGE_RANGE, NOTE

ITEM_ID, DOC_ID, IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, ROW_NO, FIELD_NO, FIELD_NAME, ITEM_NO, PARENT_NO, ITEM_NAME, CONTENT, BUDGET_STATE_CD, BUDGET_AMOUNT, BUDGET_UNIT_CD, BUDGET_YEARS, PAGE_NO, CHECK_CD, PROGRESS_CD, EXEC_RATE, NOTE
mapper.select: SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT NAME_KO FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE UPPER(INSTITUTION_ID) = UPPER(#{institutionId})
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID AS INSTITUTION_ID, NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, REGION_CODE AS REGION_CODE, TYPE AS INST_TYPE FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE UPPER(INSTITUTION_ID) IN UPPER(#{id})

SELECT CODE_GROUP AS CODE_GROUP, CODE AS CODE, CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE ENABLED = 1 AND CODE_GROUP IN ('PLAN_SRC_KIND', 'PLAN_CHECK', 'PLAN_BUDGET_STATE', 'PLAN_BUDGET_UNIT', 'PLAN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY CODE_GROUP, SORT_NO
SELECT FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE IMPORT_ID = (SELECT MAX(IMPORT_ID) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND ORIGIN_CD = #{originCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND FILE_SHA256 = #{sha}
SELECT FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE IMPORT_ID IN (SELECT MAX(IMPORT_ID) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID) ORDER BY INSTITUTION_ID
SELECT IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, FILE_DATE, ITEM_COUNT FROM INST_NEWS_IMPORT WHERE IMPORT_ID IN (SELECT MAX(IMPORT_ID) FROM INST_NEWS_IMPORT GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID) ORDER BY INSTITUTION_ID
SELECT FROM INST_PLAN_DOC WHERE IMPORT_ID IN (SELECT MAX(IMPORT_ID) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID) ORDER BY IMPORT_ID, DOC_SEQ
SELECT FROM INST_PLAN_DOC WHERE IMPORT_ID = #{importId} ORDER BY DOC_SEQ
SELECT FROM INST_PLAN_ITEM WHERE IMPORT_ID = #{importId} ORDER BY DOC_ID, ROW_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INST_PLAN_IMPORT (INSTITUTION_ID, ORIGIN_CD, FILE_DATE, FILE_SHA256, FILE_BYTES, ITEM_COUNT, DOC_COUNT, WARN_COUNT, BATCH_ID, IMPORTED_BY, IMPORTED_AT, IMPORTED_VERIFIED) VALUES (#{institutionId}, #{originCd}, #{fileDate}, #{fileSha256}, #{fileBytes}, #{itemCount}, #{docCount}, #{warnCount}, #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{importedBy}, #{importedAt}, #{importedVerified})

INSERT INTO INST_PLAN_DOC (IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, DOC_SEQ, TITLE, SRC_KIND_CD, PERIOD_FROM, PERIOD_TO, SRC_URL, URL_MISSING, CHECKED_ON, COLLECTOR_AGENT, PAGE_RANGE, NOTE) VALUES (#{importId}, #{institutionId}, #{docSeq}, #{title}, #{srcKindCd}, #{periodFrom}, #{periodTo}, #{srcUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{urlMissing}, #{checkedOn}, #{collectorAgent}, #{pageRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO INST_PLAN_ITEM (DOC_ID, IMPORT_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, ROW_NO, FIELD_NO, FIELD_NAME, ITEM_NO, PARENT_NO, ITEM_NAME, CONTENT, BUDGET_STATE_CD, BUDGET_AMOUNT, BUDGET_UNIT_CD, BUDGET_YEARS, PAGE_NO, CHECK_CD, PROGRESS_CD, EXEC_RATE, NOTE) VALUES (#{docId}, #{importId}, #{institutionId}, #{rowNo}, #{fieldNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fieldName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{itemNo}, #{parentNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{itemName}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{budgetStateCd}, #{budgetAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{budgetUnitCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{budgetYears,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pageNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{checkCd}, #{progressCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{execRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO INST_PLAN_ACT (INSTITUTION_ID, IMPORT_ID, ACTION_CD, OUTCOME, ITEM_COUNT, FILE_SHA256, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{institutionId}, #{importId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{actionCd}, #{outcome}, #{itemCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sha,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empVerified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{loggedAt})
